scope: Section 5 object and field coverage, logical primitive types and local reference targets, base required/read-only settings, default detail forms, display field, and inheritance. Configuration inspection only; no tenant records or configuration were modified.

findings.finding: BOMECS Include All Facilities? is absent. Include All Families? (InclAllFamilies) exists instead.
findings.action: Confirm the intended meaning and correct the field definition and receive mapping to match includeAllFacilities. Do not assume family applicability is facility applicability.

findings.finding: The part object caption is BOMECS API Record; the specification caption is BOMECS Part API Recod.
findings.action: Reconcile the agreed display name with the specification. Existing system name remains identified independently.

findings.finding: 59 of 60 present fields/grids identified as source-controlled or read-only in the checklist have no explicit read-only field/default-form setting. Included in Latest Part Feed? alone has EditReadOnly=true.
findings.action: Review source controls and inverse-grid editing on receiving screens. Keep expressly editable local catalogue fields and supplier Role editable. Conditional immutability still needs lifecycle enforcement.

findings.finding: All 39 present unconditionally required expected fields are mandatory in the default detail forms, but all have IsRequired=false in field metadata.
findings.action: Confirm the receive service enforces persisted required values. UI mandatory markers alone are not proof of API validation. No invalid writes were attempted.

findings.finding: The BOMECS Revisions grid exists but its default detail markup declares no Included in Latest Part Feed?=TRUE filter.
findings.action: Confirm or configure the default latest-feed filter while retaining access to historical revision rows.
Reconcile object auditing with the specification requirement for native audit history and retained prior source evidence.

unverified: Exact text lengths, Notes/Description/Comment native long-text capacity, Raw Payload 1 MiB UTF-8 capacity, and Unit Cost precision 19/scale 6 were not exposed by the returned base metadata projection.
Exact relationship cardinalities, disabled inverses, and the four inverse pairings are not proven by target-type matches alone. Two appropriate physical M:N maps exist.

Composite uniqueness, null-equality scope keys, source-namespace enforcement, source immutability, conditional requiredness, and receive synchronization behavior need integration/configuration evidence beyond these projections.
No effective permission impersonation, save tests, business payload reads, integration executions, or tenant writes were performed.
